title: Division on individual twisted cohomology groups
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module], F any O_X-module, and s a global section of L. Write H^p(W,G) for open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. Let S be an open with underlying set nonvanishingLocus L s [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There are additive maps q(W,p,n):H^p(W,F tensor L^n) -> H^p(W intersect S,F), for all opens W and p,n >= 0, such that multiplication by s^n applied to q(W,p,n)(xi) is the restriction of xi, and q(W,p,n+b)(s^b xi)=q(W,p,n)(xi) for every b >= 0. Multiplication by s^n on H^p(W intersect S,F) is bijective onto H^p(W intersect S,F tensor L^n).

source.place: Tag 09MR, canonical fraction comparison and Mayer--Vietoris paragraph; Tag 01EB naturality

proof.text: Use nonvanishing_section_trivializes and uniqueness of scalar coefficients on every smaller open to show that s(1) is an IsFreeGenerator on S. The proved source lemmas isFreeGenerator_tensorPowSectionOne and IsFreeGenerator.bijective_tmulSection_right give sectionwise bijectivity of m_n = (rho_F).inv followed by F tensor s^n on every open below W intersect S. Reflect isomorphisms through the faithful underlying presheaf functor to obtain IsIso of overFunctor.map m_n.

Apply openModuleCohomology_map_isIso_of_overFunctor to obtain bijectivity on cohomology. Form the additive equivalence e(W,p,n) from this bijection, and define q as its inverse composed with the cohomology restriction. The inverse law gives the division formula; the same bijectivity gives the final assertion.

Prove the equality m_n followed by mulTensorPowSection n b = m_(n+b) by extensionality on sections and the proved source lemma mulTensorPowSection_app_tmulSection. Apply injectivity of the cohomology map m_(n+b) to the transition equation. Naturality of openModuleCohomologyRestriction, the functor composition law, and the division formula make both sides equal.

theorem exists_cohomologySection_division (X : Scheme.{uMV})
    (L F : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (S : X.Opens) (_hS : (S : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus L s) :
    ∃ q : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n : ℕ),
      (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) →+
        (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).obj F,
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n : ℕ)
        (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).map
            (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
              F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))
            (q W p n ξ) =
          (openModuleCohomologyRestriction X.toRingedSpace p
            (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ S ≤ W))).app (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules) ξ) ∧
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n b : ℕ)
        (ξ : (openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).obj
          (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)),
        q W p (n + b) ((openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p W).map
          (mulTensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) F n b) ξ) = q W p n ξ) ∧
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (p n : ℕ), Function.Bijective
        ((openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (W ⊓ S)).map
          (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
            F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules))))
